Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the film was "The Kid" (2000) despite the WebSurfer explicitly confirming that the Wikipedia page for "Unbreakable" lists "Blinding Edge Pictures" as a production company. The Planner hallucinated a different film title ("The Kid") to match the production company found, ignoring the correct film title ("Unbreakable") identified in the previous steps and the search results. This was a critical failure in synthesizing the gathered information correctly.
